args.summary: Customer reports a credit card statement payment taken from checking but not reflected on the card statement balance (Backend Incident 11/13). Both initial transfer tools have been run.
args.reason: Backend Incident 11/13 payment reflection discrepancy; third transfer request

steps.quote: Only use the regular transfer_to_human_agents tool after the user has made their third transfer request and both initial tools have been executed.

steps.do: If the window has closed, use standard handling: verify identity per policy (any 2 of DOB, email, phone, address, then log_verification), look up card accounts and transactions, and offer a human transfer only if nothing in the knowledge base resolves the issue

rules.rule: The incident protocol applies only if the current time (from get_current_time) is on or before 11/15/2025, 11:59 PM EST
rules.quote: Follow this incident-specific transfer protocol for reports matching the symptoms below until 11/15/2025, 11:59 PM EST. After that time, revert to standard handling.

rules.rule: All three symptoms must be present: the statement was paid, the amount was taken from checking, and the payment is not reflected on the card statement balance
rules.quote: Use this flow only when a customer reports ALL of the following:

rules.rule: Do not verify identity under this protocol
rules.quote: Do not ask for verification information or attempt to verify the user's identity.

rules.rule: Run the two initial tools in a fixed order, 1822 and then 0218. Unlock each one before calling it, and do not skip either.
rules.quote: Note: Always maintain this order. Each tool must be unlocked before it can be called. Do not skip steps.

rules.rule: Do not try to fix the discrepancy in the chat (for example with a statement credit or a new payment) and do not collect extra details
rules.quote: Do not collect additional details or attempt to resolve the payment reflection discrepancy in-chat during the incident window.

jobs.done_when: Inside the window: both initial tools (1822 and then 0218) have been unlocked and called on the first and second transfer requests, and transfer_to_human_agents has been called on the third request. Outside the window: standard handling has been completed.
